volumes.title: Shadows of the Infinite
volumes.tagline: The Infinity Codex is stolen, and the Ultras are born.
volumes.intro: Victor Cross and O.R.A.C.L.E. bring together Trauma Hawk, Thunder Bolt, Steel Talon and Silver Star to recover a stolen artifact, and a team of heroes becomes the Ultras.

missions.title: The Codex Is Stolen
missions.summary: Victor Cross sends the team after Copperhead and the stolen Infinity Codex.
body: The heroes (Trauma Hawk, Thunder Bolt, Steel Talon, and Silver Star) were brought together by the leader of O.R.A.C.L.E., Victor Cross, and given a vital mission: recover the powerful artifact known as the Infinity Codex. The Codex had been stolen from O.R.A.C.L.E. headquarters by the sinister villain Copperhead and a group of armed mercenaries.

After being briefed by Cross and getting to know one another a bit better, the heroes first set out to question criminal informant Frankie Vega. They found Vega at his usual hangout, the Muddy Pig. After some convincing, Vega guided them to an abandoned air strip where they encountered Copperhead and his mercenaries.

After a hard-fought battle that almost saw the end of two of our heroes, they defeated Copperhead and set about questioning him. He revealed that he was hired by a powerful villain, Dr. Psionic, to steal the Codex and deliver it to a group of brilliant scientists and technologists known as the Genesis Alliance. He was no longer in possession of the Infinity Codex. It had been taken from him, along with the cargo plane they were meant to escape in. Copperhead didn't know for sure who took it, but he suspected the Genesis Alliance, taking possession of the artifact before Copperhead had the chance to double cross them. He gave the heroes coordinates to the secret desert base of the Genesis Alliance.

missions.title: The Desert Base
missions.summary: Tungsten Titan joins the team as they infiltrate the Genesis Alliance in Nevada.
body: The heroes continued their mission to locate the stolen Infinity Codex by traveling to the Great Basin Desert in Nevada. Before they left, they were introduced to another hero who joined the team, the powerful Tungsten Titan. Aboard the O.R.A.C.L.E. mission jet, the team got to know each other a bit better before they set about infiltrating the base of the Genesis Alliance.

After they overcame a few challenges getting into the base, they neutralized the guards and came face to face with the leaders of the Genesis Alliance, Adrian Blackwell and Evelyn Stone. Blackwell and Stone were not keen on giving up the Codex without a fight and sent a squad of Assassin Drones against our heroes.

After a hard-fought battle, the heroes defeated the scientists, but not before the evil Dr. Psionic swooped in and took the Infinity Codex for himself. On the ride back to New York, Victor Cross was able to give a little additional information on Dr. Psionic, also known as Arthur Cromwell.

missions.title: The Fall of Dr. Psionic
missions.summary: A deadly trap, an attack on New York, and a city that fights back.
body: The heroes were then able to determine the location of Dr. Psionic's secret lair and attempted to infiltrate the compound. After fighting their way to a large underground chamber, they discovered it was a trap to drown them underground. After some quick thinking, they escaped the dangerous trap.

They then heard that Dr. Psionic was attacking New York City. He was using the Infinity Codex to boost his already formidable powers and trying to mind control all the citizens of the city. The heroes rallied the citizens of New York to fight back against the powerful villain, and together they managed to defeat him in Times Square.
Dr. Psionic is now locked away in a special facility for super villains along with fellow captured villain Copperhead, and the Infinity Codex has been safely returned to O.R.A.C.L.E.
Blackwell and Stone, defeated by the Ultras in their attempt to recover the Codex, later cut a deal with O.R.A.C.L.E. to stay out of prison, and now work for the organization.

volumes.title: Havoc Unleashed
volumes.tagline: A new threat strikes the city the Ultras have sworn to protect.
volumes.intro: Since their encounter with Dr. Psionic in Times Square, the Ultras have become full-time crime fighters, living in a state-of-the-art facility in upstate New York. Then a new group of villains calling themselves Havoc appears.

missions.title: Ultras Day
missions.summary: The Ultras have a new home, a new name and a new enemy.
body: Since their encounter with Dr. Psionic in Times Square, Thunder Bolt, Steel Talon, Silver Star, Trauma Hawk, and the Tungsten Titan have become full-time crime fighters. They have left their old lives behind, all moving into a new state-of-the-art facility in upstate New York. And while their hero personas are well known, their personal identities aren't currently known to the public. They have integrated with O.R.A.C.L.E., using that organization for intelligence in taking down criminals and also for technology to aid in their crime fighting.

After the high-profile encounter in Times Square, our heroes enjoyed a surge of popularity, becoming the toast of the town. After the New York Times dubbed the heroes "The Ultras", they were bombarded from all sides with requests for appearances, endorsements, and problems for them to solve which don't always qualify as real "superhero" problems. They tried to be selective with their public appearances as they were busy furnishing their new headquarters with everything they might need.

The heroes accepted an invitation from the Mayor of New York to attend "Ultras Day". However, the festivities were interrupted by a new group of villains calling themselves Havoc. Their leader, Shockwave, orchestrated an attack on the parade being held to celebrate Ultras Day. Through some quick thinking and teamwork, the heroes thwarted the attack and kept civilian injuries to a minimum, but doubt lingered over whether they would be able to protect the citizens of New York from this new threat.

Along with a new friend and fellow hero, Lynee Boackle, aka Bones, they investigated this group known as Havoc. They consulted with Victor Cross and O.R.A.C.L.E. and also had a fruitful chat with Frankie Vega. They discovered an address that might lead them to even more information. Right when they were ready to act on it, Shockwave reached out through the media to deliver another ominous warning.

missions.title: Reservoir and Assembly
missions.summary: Havoc strikes the Hillview Reservoir and the UN at the same time.
body: Before the heroes could even decide their next move, Havoc attacked the Hillview Reservoir, and the villain Blast Freeze froze a large portion of it before Thunder Bolt, Silver Star, and the Tungsten Titan intervened. There was a large battle in which the villain Mosquito made some cringe-worthy jokes and puns. The Ultras ultimately chose to save civilians in the nearby office building from a fire started by the villain Blaze rather than pursue the villains as they fled, but they did find a communication device that could be their next clue to unraveling this story.

Meanwhile, Shockwave and Kill Zone attacked the UN General Assembly meeting, which led to a battle with Steel Talon and Trauma Hawk, who quickly flew to the rescue. After a tough battle with the powerful villains, the heroes were joined by Bones and managed to save all the Assembly members from falling debris caused by Shockwave.

Bones had just come from a crime scene: the murder of a lawyer, Erwin Lancaster. There she had discovered a new villain who would be joining forces with Havoc, Lynx, and she had collected a laptop that could hold the key to unlocking the next chapter of our story.

missions.title: Old Faces
missions.summary: A laptop and a communication device lead back to Genesis Technologies.
body: The Ultras took the recovered communication device to O.R.A.C.L.E. while Bones followed up with the laptop at the NYPD Forensics Lab. The communication device was made by a familiar name, Genesis Technologies. That turned out to be Dr. Adrian Blackwell and Dr. Evelyn Stone, formerly of the Genesis Alliance, now reformed and working for O.R.A.C.L.E.

The laptop held the profiles of five villains: Blast Freeze, Mosquito, Blaze, Kill Zone and Lynx. Shockwave had had the lawyer Erwin Lancaster recruit them and put those profiles together, and Shockwave's own profile was not among them. Lynx had murdered Lancaster to tie up a loose end, because Havoc was afraid he could identify them to the police or the Ultras.

The Ultras spoke with Blackwell and Stone and learned that they had been working on experimental gravity amplification devices, and that a Maxwell Reed had commissioned the communication devices and had inquired about the gravity devices. That name would turn out to belong to Shockwave. Days later, the gravity devices were stolen. These machines could be very dangerous if their safety protocols were overwritten.

The Ultras finally put the whole picture together. The reservoir had been frozen to stop the water flow into the city so that the gravity devices could be loaded into the empty pipe network. The Ultras would need to head underground.

missions.title: Under the City
missions.summary: The Ultras take the fight to Havoc beneath New York.
body: Working together as a team, the Ultras disabled each of the three gravity devices. That led to a showdown with Havoc underground. After some back and forth fighting, the heroes gained the upper hand, and Shockwave snapped, unleashing the full power of his suit in a sonic overload that threatened to bring the entire tunnel down on everyone inside it.
In the chaos, Shockwave and Lynx were captured, but the other four members of Havoc escaped. Without their leader, the threat of Havoc was defeated, for now.
In the aftermath, O.R.A.C.L.E. analysts found a code name that was mentioned as funding the Havoc operation: "The Architect".

rollCall.note: Joined in Shadows of the Infinite

volumes.title: Ghost Ledger
volumes.intro: The next chapter in the Ultras' story is still under wraps.

openThreads.title: The Architect
openThreads.text: A code name that O.R.A.C.L.E. analysts found mentioned as funding the Havoc operation. Nobody knows who it is.

openThreads.title: Four members of Havoc remain at large
openThreads.text: Blast Freeze, The Mosquito, Blaze and Kill Zone escaped from the final battle beneath the city.
